articles.title: Astronomers Discover Two 'Super-Puff' Planets Lighter Than Cotton Candy
articles.summary: Two Jupiter-sized exoplanets called TOI-791 b and c are so fluffy they're less dense than cotton candy. Volunteers spotted them in NASA data, and telescopes in Antarctica confirmed the find.

articles.title: iPhone 18 Pro Review: The Camera Finally Gets a Variable Aperture
articles.summary: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max introduce a variable aperture camera that adjusts like a pupil, starting at $1,199. But with no base iPhone 18 this year, most people should wait until spring 2027.

articles.title: Resident Evil Reboot Has No Post-Credits Scene, Director Confirms
articles.summary: Zach Cregger's new Resident Evil movie has no post-credits scene, so you can leave when the credits roll. The reboot tells a new story with new characters, set in the game universe.
